abstract_evidence_excerpt: Temperature-related profiles of fresh leachate properties, like chemical oxygen demand (COD), were observed. However, an excessive OLR at 36.55 kg-COD/m3/d at HRT of 1 d resulted in a sharp decrease in key microbes, such as archaea (from 37% to 15%), finally leading to the deterioration of AnMBR.
